name: finish_on_visible_conversation
description: Recording A's conversation is done and on Home with a title and notes at 400 s; Finish is tapped at 410 s with nothing in progress. The server answers that nothing is open (the 404 of #26241 / #26242: an already-closed Finish is not a failure), and Home keeps the conversation's title and notes in one conversation: no blank copy.

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 (177 reads, 48 writes, 1 delete(s), 4 no-op, 0 STT, 7 LLM; caps about +10%). noop_writes=4 is the current count, not a target: every one is database/conversations_v3_leases.py:72 renew (service.reconcile run_blocking renew) rewriting the lease until at the instant it was claimed. The lab clock does not move inside one event; production's does, so this is a lab-clock repeat, reported in the PR.
